notes: Draft. Covers all of ABSTRACT and ABSTRACT_MORE (80 words) plus 18 extra abstract words not in any pool. Each entry: the word, a sound-alike made of easy words, one picture and a short note on how close the match is. The soundalike is a memory hook only. Keyword and sound-alike pictures fade without retrieval (Dunlosky and colleagues 2013 rate the keyword method low for lasting learning), so the app should pair these with spaced checks and show the real word after the answer. Homophone pairs are spelling-different words that sound the same in most accents; a few pairs (for example cereal and serial, plain and plane) depend slightly on accent. Pair lists are common English homophones from general knowledge, not from any one source. Fact-check: the Dunlosky and colleagues 2013 reference (Psychological Science in the Public Interest 14(1), 4-58, https://doi.org/10.1177/1529100612453266) rates the keyword mnemonic low utility, confirmed Nov 2, 2026. All 45 homophone pairs were read and are true homophones in most accents; cereal and serial, plain and plane, and a few others depend slightly on accent.
honestLimit: This is fast to start and fades without checks. It is a way to get a first picture for an abstract word, not the best long-term way to keep vocabulary.
